query.description: Search query — what are you looking for?

n_results.description: Page size — number of similarity hits per page (default: 5, max: {max_results})

folder.description: Folder to restrict the search to. Includes all nested sub-folders automatically — pass 'bibel' to search both Schlachter and GuteNachricht, 'judaica' to search everything Jewish, 'bibel/Schlachter' to narrow to one translation. Omit to search across all indexed content.

page.description: 1-based page number for pagination. page=1 (default) returns the top similarity hits, page=2 the next batch deeper into the ranking, etc. Use the SAME query when paginating. Watch has_more in the response to decide whether another page is worth fetching.
